subject: Staggered handoffs: MAP milestones, evidence windows & order-form gating (AuroraThera)
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Sasha Berg <sasha.berg@aurorathera.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 7 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Staggered handoffs: MAP milestones, evidence windows & order-form gating (AuroraThera)

Hi Sasha — great to meet you yesterday. Following up with a proposed minimal-risk sequence so AuroraThera can start evaluation without legal/procurement blocking the pilot. Key asks are below; attaching a draft MAP and our SOC2 summary for your security team.

Short summary (ask):
- We want to run a 6-week pilot starting with a 2-week sandbox evaluation, then a 4-week pilot under a limited MSA/order form so you can measure latency and integration effort.
- Procurement requested a redlineable MSA + order form; we can deliver MSA-draft-v1.docx today.
- Security evidence: short SOC2 artifact + pen-test window. SOC2 summary attached; full report available via a signed NDA.

Proposed sequencing (high level):
1) Week 0–1: API onboarding & token access (no billing) — Dev access only.
2) Week 2: Sandbox evaluation (MAP milestone A) — acceptance criteria: 5 test prompts, integration checklist.
3) Week 3–4: Technical handoff & evidence exchange (security + procurement review).
4) Week 5–6: Order form for pilot + billing enablement; target signature by end of week 6.

Open questions for you:
- Procurement timeline: can they review an order form on a 5-business-day cadence?
- Do you require SOC2 Type II full report before pilot billing is enabled, or is the summary + contract clause acceptable for a pilot?

Attachments: MAP-draft-AuroraThera.xlsx (spreadsheet), redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (pdf), MSA-draft-v1.docx (docx)

Thanks — Laura

--
Laura Bennett
Senior Manager, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123
From: Sasha Berg <sasha.berg@aurorathera.com>

Date: Fri, 7 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Staggered handoffs: MAP milestones, evidence windows & order-form gating (AuroraThera)

Laura — thanks for the clear plan and the attachments. A few notes from procurement/security: 

- Procurement: 5-business-day review for an order form is optimistic; our typical turnaround is 7–10 business days unless we push. Also need to confirm PO/line item mapping for pilot billing (we prefer a single pilot line item).
- Security: summary looks good but we will request the Type II report if we move beyond pilot. For pilot billing enablement we can accept the summary + a contractual audit clause; internal security will want a pen-test schedule in week 3.

On sequencing: if you can separate the token provisioning (dev-only) from billing enablement that helps — we can start API calls internally while procurement processes the order.

Tom from procurement is cc'd — Tom, can you confirm whether your team can do a 7-business-day review on a redline?

Thanks,
Sasha

--
Sasha Berg
Head of Integrations
AuroraThera

Subject: Re: Staggered handoffs: MAP milestones, evidence windows & order-form gating (AuroraThera)

Thanks Sasha — appreciate the clarity. Short replies inline.

> Procurement: 7–10 business days
Understood. We'll plan for 10 business days in the MAP and treat the order-form signature as a pilot gating milestone (MAP Milestone 3).

> Security: need Type II for post-pilot; pen-test schedule in week 3
We can offer a vendor-led pen-test week 3–4; Redwood will commit to scheduling and will share scope ahead of time. NDA will unlock the full SOC2 Type II if needed.

Operational adjustments we will make: 
- Split the onboarding into two tokens: DEV (no billing) and PILOT (billing flag disabled until order form signs).
- Provide an evidence bundle (access logs, retention policy excerpt, and SOC2 summary) by end of day Monday.
- Add a clause to MSA-draft-v1.docx that limits pilot data persistence to 30 days unless otherwise agreed.

Action items: 
- Laura to deliver updated MAP with 10-business-day procurement cadence + token split (attached as MAP-draft-AuroraThera.xlsx v1.1).
- Karthik to prepare an acceptance checklist (technical criteria) and slot a pen-test week.
- Tom / Procurement: confirm PO mapping and whether a pilot line item is required.

Attaching: MAP-draft-AuroraThera.xlsx (v1.1) — small edits reflected.

Thanks — Laura

Subject: Re: Staggered handoffs: MAP milestones, evidence windows & order-form gating (AuroraThera)

Hi all — quick technical sequencing note to make the pilot low-friction and to protect both teams' timelines.

Proposal (technical swimlane):
- Day 0–3: Issue DEV token to AuroraThera engineering (scoped to a sandbox account) — verify connectivity and sample throughput tests (no billing).
- Day 4–14: Sandbox evaluation (MAP M1) — AuroraThera runs 5 canonical prompts; Redwood provides an acceptance checklist (attached below).
- Day 15–21: Pen-test window and evidence exchange — Redwood shares access log slices and retention excerpt; AuroraThera runs an internal pen-test and notifies Redwood of issues.
- Day 22–30: Convert DEV -> PILOT token (billing remains off until order-form signature). If procurement finishes earlier we can flip billing sooner.

Acceptance checklist (excerpt):
- API auth success under 100ms for 95th percentile in sample tests
- Response fidelity: sample prompt set F1 score >= threshold (we'll share the eval harness)
- Integration hooks: callback reliability >= 99.5% for webhook delivery in 24h window

Risks & mitigations:
- Procurement delay (7–10 business days): We gate billing on signature and allow integration to proceed with DEV token so security doesn't block engineering progress.
- Evidence request overload: Redwood will provide a curated bundle (SOC2 summary + logs excerpt) and make the full report available after NDA.

I'll attach the acceptance checklist and drop in a short runbook for the pen-test schedule. Laura — if you want I can join procurement calls Monday morning to unblock any PO mapping questions.

Thanks,
Karthik
